name: claude-zen
description: Self-hosted autonomous AI software delivery platform with a multi-provider gateway.

scripts.build:ui: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build

comments.test: The test/*.test.mjs glob is required. `node --test test/` resolves 'test/' as a module path on Node 24 and dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
comments.setup: Run `npm install` (or `npm ci`) before starting the orchestrator or running tests — lib/orchestrator's HTTP transport needs Hono. The gateways (zen-proxy/codex/antigravity) stay dependency-free and run from a bare checkout.
comments.dependencies: Hono is the HTTP transport boundary ONLY. Domain engines and SQLite repositories must remain framework-independent so they stay callable from tests, the CLI, and a future transport; see docs/orchestrator/current-architecture.md. Adding any further runtime dependency to lib/ is an architectural decision, not a convenience.
